sources.title: loki-mode README.md
sources.locator: Install; First run; What you get; Models/providers; Control Plane; Requirements
sources.finding: Local coding factory starts from a task/PRD/issue, builds/verifies and seals a signed receipt before PR publication. Current providers are Claude Code/Agent SDK and OpenCode. Codex/Cline/Aider/Gemini are removed.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/CLI-CORE-VERBS.md
sources.finding: CLI starts and inspects runs, chat steers/controls attached runs. Detached run survives terminal/logout but needs host kept awake; self-hosted runner is recommended for closed-laptop continuity.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/control-plane-migration.md
sources.locator: Current UI; Start the Control Plane; Route mapping; Not yet available
sources.finding: Control Plane replaces classic dashboard, with /v1 run list/detail/events/artifacts, start/stop/resume/retry/verify/answer and merge queue/risk routes. Current UI has one bearer token, not RBAC/OIDC; machine-mutating routes are loopback-only.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/TOOL-INTEGRATION.md
sources.finding: Product exposes an MCP stdio integration and API/editor clients; file-based memory/events coordinate tools. Legacy dashboard API is distinct from current Control Plane UI.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/WORKSPACES.md
sources.finding: Workspace groups repos with after dependencies and default concurrency two. Independent repos run concurrently in worktrees; dependent repos skip if predecessors fail. Integration can gate stages and signed composite binds child receipts/head SHAs/log digest.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/DOCKER.md
sources.finding: Docker wrapper mounts repo .loki state and provider credentials. Claude Max/Pro login reuse documented; older dashboard-port examples are not current UI authority.

sources.title: loki-mode CHANGELOG.md
sources.finding: Newest release changes would-be ambiguous stops into best-reading work capped at PARTIAL, with optional tool-less Opus consult. This is narrower/newer than README wording saying such runs stop to ask.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/AGENT-CHANGE-RECEIPT.md
sources.locator: Fields; Verify the signature; DSSE export
sources.finding: Receipt schema binds task hash, base/head/tree/diff hashes, check outcomes, not_proven, cost/time and event-log digest to Ed25519 signature. Unrecorded cost/time fields remain unknown.

sources.locator: What deploy gate trusts; Honest limits
sources.finding: Deploy verifies signature against trusted key set. Signature proves origin/integrity, not correctness; post-deploy health and rollback status are separate recorded facts.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/OPEN-CORE-BOUNDARY.md
sources.finding: Existing self-hosted core is free and fully functional with no Loki account/license key/hosted backend. Paid hosted/enterprise layers are future additive seams, not evidence of existing product availability.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/PRIVACY.md
sources.finding: Anonymous diagnostics default on for interactive individual installs, auto-off in CI/enterprise/air-gap/noninteractive contexts; documented CLI/environment opt-outs. Provider network traffic governed separately.

sources.title: loki-mode docs/examples/loki-issue-to-pr.yml.example
sources.locator: Example issue and comment triggers; separate agent/publish jobs
sources.finding: Official copyable workflow reacts to a loki issue label or authorized /loki comment, with per-issue concurrency. Read-only agent job emits patch; separate publisher job opens PR. User must install/configure this GitHub integration.

sources.title: Loki Mode README, providers
sources.locator: README.md line 127 (providers paragraph), release tag v11.138.0 (commit d05e200)
sources.finding: The README states that two providers are supported, Claude Code (claude CLI or Agent SDK) and OpenCode; codex, cline, aider and gemini were removed and exit with a migration message.

sources.title: Current native storage and issue intake
sources.locator: schema runs/issue_ref and events; server/routes/index.ts; commands/issues_run.ts; autonomy/lib/backlog.py
sources.finding: The current Control Plane stores run projections and linked external issue references, not independent native issue/backlog records. The route registry exposes run controls and GitHub issue reads; the CLI backlog intake fetches external GitHub/Jira/Linear work and immediately plans/runs it. No separate native draft issue CRUD/lifecycle exists in this bounded current implementation.

sources.title: Current Control Plane identity boundary
sources.finding: The current server authenticates one LOKI_CONTROL_TOKEN, with local mutation guards and no distinct human accounts, invites or user-role checks. Retired /api/collab routes explicitly return 410 in the compatibility route table. This establishes the current absence of a distinct-human shared-prompting workflow; sharing the one token remains one identity.

sources.title: Loki worker isolation scope
sources.locator: engine supervisor and provider subprocesses; docs/DOCKER.md; current provider/Control Plane tree
sources.finding: The bounded released engine dispatches local provider subprocesses and Git worktrees, with an optional Docker wrapper. The inspected runtime and deployment paths contain no product-owned VM allocator or per-task VM isolation; a VM chosen externally by a self-host operator is not a Loki isolation technique.
